body.x: 1Drop will exhibit in vitro diagnostic medical devices using smartphones at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri).

1Drop is a spin-off company of SamsungElectronics, and was founded in 2017 based on the idea of ​​measuring bodyfluids using a smartphone. In-vitro diagnostic medical devices using smartphones can be managed with a drop of fluid by using an in-vitro diagnosticsystem using smart phones, smart phone cases, smart phone apps, and biosensors.

The company also implemented a simplestructure biosensor with high cost competitiveness by utilizing single membraneplasma separation technology. In addition, by using the flash and camera of thesmartphone, the cost of the equipment required for the measurement can be reduced.

In addition, the use of traditionalcolorimetric biosensors and smartphones makes it easy to add measurement items.With a user-centric interface, built-in wireless communications, and flexibleapplications on smartphones, healthcare can be made easier and smarter.
